Optimize local SEO schema markup specifically for Dr. Sonia Fiedalan Pareño and SFP Dental Clinic to capture higher local search intent in Cebu.

audit.summary: The SFP Dental Clinic website benefits from clear meta descriptions targeting dental implants and cosmetic dentistry in Cebu, but suffers from running on an end-of-life Drupal 7 architecture. Upgrading the platform and focusing on conversion-driven design will significantly improve security, user engagement, and patient acquisition.

outreach.subject: Quick thought on the SFP Dental Clinic site
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I was looking over your site while researching dental care in Cebu and noticed it's currently running on Drupal 7, which recently reached its end-of-life. That unfortunately leaves the platform exposed to unpatched security vulnerabilities.

I also spotted a few areas where the page content is getting cut off in the layout, which can make it tough for prospective patients to get all the details they need before booking.

We put together a quick, modern demo showing how a refreshed version of the site could look and feel. Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul

problems.issue: Relying solely on a Facebook profile instead of a dedicated business website limits brand ownership, professional credibility, and advanced SEO capabilities.

problems.impact: Reduces readability and professionalism for prospective patients reading the clinic's core value proposition.

problems.issue: Absence of structured contact details, operating hours, and direct booking links in the primary meta description.
problems.impact: Creates friction for potential patients trying to quickly contact or schedule an appointment with the clinic.

opportunities: Develop a dedicated, mobile-responsive website featuring online appointment booking, patient testimonials, and a service menu to complement the Facebook presence.
Implement Local SEO strategies (Google Business Profile) with clear NAP (Name, Address, Phone) data to capture high-intent local search traffic in Manila.

audit.summary: Dobles Dental Clinic has a strong legacy dating back to 1953 with a solid social media following in Manila, but heavily relies on a Facebook profile rather than a standalone website. Transitioning to a dedicated web presence with integrated booking and local SEO will improve patient acquisition and establish stronger digital authority.

outreach.subject: Quick thought on Dobles Dental Clinic's online presence
outreach.body:
Hi there,

It's incredible that Dobles Dental Clinic has been caring for smiles in Manila since 1953. 

I noticed you're currently relying entirely on your Facebook page rather than a dedicated website. Because of this, patients searching Google for specialized oral surgery or implants are likely missing out on finding you, and the styled text on your profile can sometimes appear as broken symbols on certain devices.

We actually put together a quick, modern demo website for you with built-in booking and local SEO. Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul
